name: agent-control-plane
description: Single local runtime authority that turns managed project intent into verified production-ready results

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/review/frontier-simplify.md dist/review/frontier-simplify.md && cp src/db/schema.sql dist/db/schema.sql && cp src/db/schema-v37.sql dist/db/schema-v37.sql && cp src/db/schema-v44.sql dist/db/schema-v44.sql && cp src/db/schema-v45.sql dist/db/schema-v45.sql && cp src/db/schema-v46.sql dist/db/schema-v46.sql && cp src/db/schema-v47.sql dist/db/schema-v47.sql && cp src/db/schema-v48.sql dist/db/schema-v48.sql && cp src/db/schema-v49.sql dist/db/schema-v49.sql && cp src/db/schema-v50.sql dist/db/schema-v50.sql && cp src/db/schema-v51.sql dist/db/schema-v51.sql && cp src/db/schema-v52.sql dist/db/schema-v52.sql && cp src/db/schema-v53.sql dist/db/schema-v53.sql && cp src/db/schema-v54.sql dist/db/schema-v54.sql && cp src/db/schema-v55.sql dist/db/schema-v55.sql && node scripts/copy-native-fd-vfs-into-dist.mjs && node scripts/copy-host-project-provisioner.mjs
scripts.ci:commitlore: set -e; D="${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/commitlore-boot"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D/.local/bin"; D="$(cd "$D" && pwd -P)"; curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$D/install.sh" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MongLong0214/commitlore/b18c40f09a4b23eaf892f6a133d297f568b240ea/install.sh; if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then shasum -a 256 "$D/install.sh"; else sha256sum "$D/install.sh"; fi | grep -q '^a319a9a5c39ff90dcec35bfa82dcd4d31b079f6a0978b455c1dd52be113045df'; s=0; HOME="$D" XDG_DATA_HOME="$D/.local/share" COMMITLORE_INSTALL_DIR="$D/.local/bin" sh "$D/install.sh" v1.7.5 || s=$?; echo "install.sh exited $s; that status reports coding-agent host wiring, so the wrapper below is what decides"; W="$D/.local/bin/commitlore"; V="$("$W" --version)"; test "$V" = 1.7.5; "$W" runtime-identity --json >"$D/identity.json"; cat "$D/identity.json"; node -e 'const f=require("node:fs");const i=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));if(i.version!=="1.7.5")throw new Error("runtime-identity reports version "+i.version);const r=f.realpathSync(process.argv[2]);const e=f.realpathSync(i.entrypoint);if(e.indexOf(r+"/")!==0)throw new Error("entrypoint is outside "+r+": "+e);console.log("runtime-identity verified: "+i.version+" at "+e)' "$D/identity.json" "$D"; echo "$D/.local/bin" >> "${GITHUB_PATH:-/dev/null}"
